title: EM'S WORLD
tickerText:
HEY MATE! I’M EM, WELCOME TO MY WORLD OR AS I LIKE TO CALL IT..... EM'S WORLD!
THIS IS THE PLACE WHERE MINI MATES COME TO PLAY, SING, DANCE, GET SILLY AND JOIN IN THE FUN!
I MAKE INTERACTIVE, HIGH-ENERGY VIDEOS FOR KIDS AGED 2-7, ALL ABOUT PLAYING AND LEARNING THROUGH SONGS AND GAMES. WE MIGHT BE DANCING WITH DINOSAURS, COUNTING FISH, KEEPING AN EYE ON THE CHEEKY PIRATES JUMPING ON THE BED OR SIMPLY SINGING, DANCING AND PLAYING TOGETHER.
WHEN YOU JOIN ME IN MY WORLD, YOU’RE NOT JUST WATCHING, YOU ARE A PART OF THE FUN!
EMMA WOLFE (THAT'S ME) IS THE CREATOR AND ENTERTAINER BEHIND EM'S WORLD. WITH A BACKGROUND IN KIDS' ENTERTAINMENT AND PERFORMING ARTS EDUCATION, I'VE SPENT YEARS ENTERTAINING KIDS AND THEIR FAMILIES. I COME FROM THE WORLD OF LIVE PERFORMANCE AND BRING ALL THE ENERGY, INTERACTION AND FUN OF A LIVE EVENT STRAIGHT TO YOUR SCREEN.
SO GRAB YOUR GROWN-UP, GET COMFY (OR DON’T… WE’LL PROBABLY BE DANCING IN A MINUTE) AND.....
COME ON, LET'S GO!
